notes: «وزعم، أنه عقل رسول الله» is Mahmud's claim about himself, not a link; the Prophet is not written as a link
«ثم أحد بني سالم» is an appositive description of Attban and is left out of the surface
The narrative from «قال كنت أصلي لقومي» onward is Attban's own account, so Attban is the last link
